judgments.reason: The model text does not articulate the claimed mechanism (that commission is included before payment so bids above coins can win), and the transcript contains no discrepancy showing an over‑budget bid winning or commission applied before payment.

The model did not state that waiting reveals sealed rival bid values and tie its reasoning to an observed advantage; the logs show sealed bids remained private and no example where P0 waited to observe rivals' committed bid values before committing.

The transcript shows settlement after all lots were sold (normal behavior). The model did not demonstrate or articulate an early settlement discrepancy (closing with unauctioned lots), so no discovery.

The model never claimed or showed that catalog purchases received the three‑coin auction commission; no catalog purchase occurred in the play, and the articulation does not describe that mechanism or an observed instance.
